hero.intro: Motion designer and video editor in Delhi NCR. I cut reels, animate brands and build After Effects tools through my studio, Pluseshot.

work.note: Landscape films and vertical reels, picked from recent projects.

vision.lines:
Cut with purpose.
Animate with intent.
Script the hook.
Build the tools.
Deliver every frame.

services.statement: Edits that hold attention, motion that explains, and tools that make both faster.
services.note: Open a category to watch the work. Most projects are short-form: property, brand and social video.
services.item1Desc: Animated explainers, kinetic type and brand motion, built in After Effects.
services.item2Desc: Story-first edits for property, brands and people, finished with sound and colour.
services.item3Desc: Hook-to-CTA reels for Instagram and YouTube Shorts, cut in 30 to 45 seconds.
services.item4Desc: ScriptUI panels and scripts, like Stash and A Click, that take the repetitive clicks out of animation.

clients.list: Square Foot Story, Stained Glass House, SKA Group
